'''Melo Centris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|human]], who worked as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Centris was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to enhance her bounty hunting skills. She took a bounty from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] to kill [[Jarid DeBell]], a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who had incurred their wrath. DeBell was going to be marrying [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], so Centris traveled to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. She arrived in [[Tolea Biqua]] on the gas planet [[Genarius]], where a group of [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] persuaded her to let them work for her. She sent the Devaronians to acquire some cake baking materials, which she used to bake a poisoned cake. She then infiltrated the wedding in disguise as an usher and planned for DeBell to consume the cake. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] realized what she was planning to do and they thwarted her plans.<ref name="AOE" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Centris attempted to release a virus into the atmosphere of the planet [[Caarimon]], in an attempt to kill off its native species, the [[Caarite]]s.<ref name="BotB">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref>
